title: 第760章 火药作坊第759章 催缴秋税
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第760章火药作坊
赵鸿朗带着江尘一路将人送到县城外，看着那一列兵卒护送着王懋的车队渐渐远去，不由叹了口气：“二郎不该如此与他说话的，怎么说也是我们的上官。”
这么一下，可谓是将王懋得罪狠了，以后他们去郡城，恐怕也会遭刁难了。
江尘表情毫不在意，说道：“我能当上县尉，与他又有什么关系？对他客气又有什么用？”
他也看出来了，这王懋本来就是抱着有枣没枣打两竿子的心思过来的。
他能给出一万多担的粮食，已是怕麻烦出的粮了。
赵鸿朗摇头：“此前自然是没什么关系，可之后你还是要在官场混的，与上官打好关系总没错的。”
他也发现了，江尘对于官场上的事情，基本上一窍不通，甚至也根本没想了解。
江尘并没说话，只扭头往里走，走了一半又停下：“县令大人若是通晓官场事务，能为和朔县节约一些税粮就好。”
他可没有心思浪费时间在这官场泥潭里打滚，自然也无心维护官场上的关系。
赵鸿朗面色一僵，也不知如何回话，还好江尘已经迈步走远了。
...........
和朔县的秋收一切顺利。
早在开春，和朔县的名声就已打出去了，秋收之时再无流匪过来袭扰了，反倒让做足了准备的江尘有些无聊。
于是便让人，赶在九月十日之前抢收了所有粟米，又赶紧补种上了豆子、荞麦之类的。
此时，一场秋雨落下，正好为这场补种加了一把力，今年的豆荞恐怕收成也会不错。
而在和朔县百姓收获的喜悦中，走路都忍不住咧嘴发笑时，江尘独自绕过小院，到了城北一处不起眼的角落。
这地界是原本丐帮的地盘，本来就是一片废墟。
江尘接管和朔县之后，在外围建起了一道矮墙，隐隐将这片地方隔绝于和朔县之外。
外边每日有捕快在暗处巡逻，暗处还有数名身形健壮的丐帮弟子盯着。

江尘沿着长长的巷道，进入墙内。
数间低矮土屋分立两侧，里面有人影走动，不时传来叮叮当当的敲打声。
这里就是江尘专门隔绝出来，用来改进武器的。
从到了和朔县之后，他将自己在镇子里开办的学院一并搬到了和朔县内，重新建了一个学堂。
又在其中抽调了几个聪明伶俐的，还有几个药房弟子帮忙试验火药。
到如今已经足一年时间了，可惜进展始终不算太快。
倒是其他各种少见的武器造了不少，比如勾镰枪，狼筅之类。甚至还在尝试制造轻弩。
content_en:
Chapter 760 Gunpowder Workshop
Zhao Honglang led Jiang Chen all the way to the outside of the county town. Seeing the line of soldiers escorting Wang Mao's motorcade gradually away, he couldn't help but sigh: "Erlang should not talk to him like this. After all, he is also our superior officer."
This can be said to have offended Wang Mao severely. I am afraid they will also encounter difficulties when they go to the county town in the future.
Jiang Chen looked unconcerned and said, "If I can become a county captain, what does it have to do with him? What's the use of being polite to him?"
He could also see that Wang Mao came here with the intention of fighting with both sides.
He was able to give out more than 10,000 loads of grain, which was enough to avoid trouble.
Zhao Honglang shook his head: "Of course there was no relationship before, but you will still have to hang out in the officialdom in the future. It is always right to have a good relationship with Shangguan."
He also discovered that Jiang Chen basically knew nothing about officialdom matters, and he didn't even want to understand them at all.
Jiang Chen didn't say anything. He just turned around and walked inside. He stopped halfway and said, "It would be great if the county magistrate is familiar with official affairs and can save some taxes and grain for Heshuo County."
He had no intention of wasting time wallowing in the quagmire of officialdom, and naturally he had no intention of maintaining official relations.
Zhao Honglang's expression froze and he didn't know how to reply. Fortunately, Jiang Chen had already walked away.
...........
The autumn harvest in Heshuo County is going well.
As early as the beginning of spring, Heshuo County's reputation had already been established. During the autumn harvest, no bandits came to harass anymore, which made Jiang Chen, who was fully prepared, a little bored.
So they sent people to harvest all the corn before September 10th, and quickly replanted beans, buckwheat and the like.
At this time, an autumn rain fell, which just added a boost to the replanting. This year's buckwheat harvest will probably be good.
And when the people of Heshuo County were enjoying their harvest and couldn't help but grin while walking, Jiang Chen walked around the small courtyard alone and arrived at an inconspicuous corner in the north of the city.
This area was originally the territory of the Beggar Clan, and it was originally a ruin.
After Jiang Chen took over Heshuo County, he built a low wall around the perimeter, faintly isolating this area from Heshuo County.
There are police officers patrolling outside in the dark every day, and there are several strong Beggar Clan disciples watching in the dark.
Jiang Chen walked along the long alley and entered the wall.
There were several low earthen houses on separate sides. There were figures walking around inside, and the sound of clanging and knocking could be heard from time to time.
This place was specially isolated by Jiang Chen to improve weapons.
After arriving in Heshuo County, he moved the college he opened in the town to Heshuo County and rebuilt a school.
Among them, a few clever people and a few pharmacy disciples were selected to help test the gunpowder.
It has been a full year now, but unfortunately the progress has not been too fast.
On the contrary, many other rare weapons were made, such as hook-and-scythe spears, wolf spears, and the like. There are even attempts to make light crossbows.
